## Summary

**ADDQ** (Add Quick): Add data to destination.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `data + Bn → Bn` |
| Syntax | `ADDQ #<data>,Bn` |
| Short | Add data to destination. |
| Description | Adds an immediate value of one to eight to the destination. Destination is a B-addr register. Size is long. |
| Condition codes | not affected |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–12 | `0101` |
| 1 | 11–9 | Data |
| 1 | 8–3 | `000001` |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |

### Example

```asm
    addq.l    #8,b1
```

```text
ea b1: .. .. .. .. 00 12 34 56
Result:
ea b1: .. .. .. .. 00 12 34 5E
```

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have ADDQ. This page covers only the 68080 addition: ADDQ with a B address register as destination. For the classic forms, the Motorola manual applies.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
